features.heading: Market Intelligence SMBs Actually Use
features.intro: Purpose-built for small business operators who need clarity, not complexity. Every feature is designed to surface the insights that drive real business decisions — without the noise of enterprise analytics tools.

cards.title: Instant Alerts
cards.body: Real-time email and in-app notifications the moment something changes — reviews, rankings, mentions, or competitor moves. Configurable thresholds keep the signal high and the noise low, so owners only hear about what actually matters.

cards.title: Brand & Competitor Monitoring
cards.body: Track brand performance and competitor activity across search, social, reviews, and ads from a single view. Side-by-side comparisons surface gaps, threats, and opportunities as they happen.

cards.title: Connect and Sync
cards.body: Integrate directly with Google Business Profile and Meta to keep listings, reviews, and posts consistent everywhere buyers look — all from one branded dashboard.

cards.title: Review Notifications
cards.body: Never miss a customer review. Get alerted to new reviews across every platform, respond fast to protect reputation, and demonstrate engagement to prospective customers reading along.

cards.title: Listings and Publishing
cards.body: Publish updates and maintain accurate business information on Google Business Profile and Meta directly from the platform — keeping profiles consistent without platform-hopping.

cards.title: Trend Insights & Performance Tracking
cards.body: Easy-to-read charts turn scattered data into clear patterns. Spot momentum early, flag problems before they grow, and hand owners a weekly story they can act on.

partnerAdvantage.heading: A Sticky Entry Point That Opens the Door to More
partnerAdvantage.intro: Brand Monitoring is more than a monitoring tool — it's your lowest-friction path to customer engagement, creating natural demand for premium marketing services.

items.title: Increase customer engagement
items.body: Real-time alerts and insights give SMBs a reason to log in regularly, keeping your brand top of mind and creating repeat touchpoints that deepen the relationship far beyond basic connectivity.

items.title: Create stickiness and drive value
items.body: Once SMBs rely on Brand Monitoring to make business decisions, the platform becomes essential to their daily workflow. That dependency translates directly into higher retention and lower churn.

items.title: Easy upsell path to premium features
items.body: Brand Monitoring is the natural gateway to Hostopia's full digital marketing portfolio. Customers who see the value of monitoring upgrade naturally to directory listings, reputation management, SEO, and advertising.
